== English errata comparison sources ==
Both English faces are titled Lieutenant Sheckil. Decipher corrects the self-reference in the immunity clause from Sumner to Sheckil. The wording of the preceding Human Shield and captive-forfeit clauses is unchanged.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=82|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 82. The entry continues on [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=83|PDF page 83]]. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=4|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 4. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=120|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 120. [[:File:CC-D-lieutenantsheckil.gif|Complete replacement face]]. The printed article retains its existing documentary identifier 5_101o. Its explicit GEMP display field is blank because the pinned Guild directory and mapping lack that class and alias.
